claim_ceiling: The purely data-driven widening rule (widen_support) is NOT unconditionally safe on the frozen four-family bank. It achieves zero false accepts on FAM-A, FAM-B, FAM-C but over-accepts 9 out-of-declared-grammar payloads in FAM-D (region-010..region-999, bids FD-OG-WRONGRANGE00..08), all of which executed and received HTTP 404 from the oracle. The widening rule is therefore falsified as a universal safe generalization. Per-family: FAM-A/FAM-B are safe+complete (coverage 1.0, FA=0); FAM-C is safe but incomplete (coverage 0.474, FA=0) due to variable-width observation; FAM-D is unsafe (FA=9, coverage 1.0) because the pinned subrange region-00[0-9] is observationally indistinguishable from a homogeneous digit run. The strong comparator B-DECLARED-FULL (FA=0, coverage=1.0) confirms the safe+complete ceiling is attainable on this bank when declared grammar is available, proving the shortfall is an identifiability limit of purely data-driven inference. No claim advance: C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE remains HYPOTHESIS. The product must ship conservative; any future shipped widening requires an independent grammar/applicability guard.
